reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COUNT(cp.product_id) AS n_checks, MIN(cp.price_eur) AS lowest_price_eur
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp
  ON cp.product_id = p.product_id
 AND cp.observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
 AND cp.observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-17 00:00:00'
WHERE p.category_id = 17
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY n_checks, p.product_id

 AND cp.observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
 AND cp.observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-17 00:00:00'
